notes.title: Pixeljam's Dino Run 2 Kickstarter Campaign
notes.notes: [p]Hello all,[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Pixeljam has always worked on multiple projects at once (with different teams), and the thing we've probably spent the most time on is a sequel to our 2008 browser game [b]Dino Run.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7182161/5d81a15e7389bb67a1a0aad4d73cec0ae03f0fec.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]It's pixel-art prehistoric multiplayer platformer with world-building tools included to let people create and share their own experiences.[/p][p align="start"]We've been either dreaming, planning, developing or crowdfunding on it since 2012 or so. We finally have enough momentum to make a final push to get to Early Access release on Steam, and if you are curious about it, please [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixeljam/the-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign?ref=9aoxr8" style="button"]click here to check out the Kickstarter Campaign[/url] we just launched.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Everyone that backs it will get immediate access to the current [b]Multiplayer Sandbox[/b], where you can explore & experiment, design & destroy, hang out and have fun alone or with friends:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7182161/3f1c7e23b2f891a3e5051580a3045158574ade27.gif"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoy it![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i][/p]

notes.title: Pixeljam's Upcoming Dino Run 2
notes.notes:
Hello All,

You may or may not know that we made a browser game 15 years ago called [b]Dino Run[/b]. Well, we are finally making a sequel and we have a coming soon page for it now.  Please wishlist it if it interests you:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590330/Dino_Run_2/

It's a single or multiplayer prehistoric platformer / runner with a lot of visuals customizations & user-made levels. You can keep up with its development via our [url=https://discord.gg/JM2MMUf]Discord[/url] server and also on [url=https://pixeljam.com/dinorun]pixeljam.com/dinorun[/url].

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10209198/f12ea75201dc7c2b9e61c7e12e87ab3e47c9514e.png[/img]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! Trading Cards, Full Controller Support and SPEEDRUN Timer.
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We just made some significant updates to Potatoman:

1) [b]TRADING CARDS[/b]. Collect your favorite characters from the game!

2) [b]FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/b].. All controllers should now work, and the d-pad can finally be used as well :)

3) [b]SPEEDRUN TIMER[/b]!  Press T (or bumpers) to toggle the timer visibility on and off.  The timer will end when you collect the 7th pyramid from the last level, and give you a link to compare your time with your friends or the rest of the world.

[b]Also, the game is now 25% off for a few more days.[/b]

Finally, Pixeljam is celebrating our 10 YEAR Anniversary this month, and we're doing a retrospective on every single game we've made... all 20 of them!

Here is the article about the making of Potatoman:
[url=pixeljam.com/blog/articles/2015/05/22/potatoman-seek-first-the-troof] http://pixeljam.com/blog/articles/2015/05/22/potatoman-seek-first-the-troof/[/url].

Check out our [url=www.twitter.com/pixeljamgames]TWITTER[/url] account for all the latest megamonth festivities!

That's all for now!  Take care...

-Miles & The Pixeljam Team

notes.title: Potatoman Will Be Released on Steam December 3rd
notes.notes:
The headline explains it rather well: we will be releasing Potatoman on Steam December 3rd!  And now, some Q & A:

Q: I already have the game, will I get a key?
A:  Yes!  Depending on where you got it, it might be delivered to you automatically (like through your humble page) or you might have to contact us and claim it .

Q: Has the game changed at all?
A: YES!  
   - We altered part of the ending sequence significantly
   - We redid the rendering engine, so now the game plays smoother, has more vibrant colors and goes into true fullscreen mode
   - We added controller support (partial)
   - Each level now has multiple color palettes, to improve replayability
   - Minor bug fixes, etc.

Q: What will it cost?
A: $3.99 USD

Q: Will I find the Troof?
A: Maybe.

Okay, that's it!  We'll be posting more info here soon.

Keep on Seekin,
-The Pixeljam Team
